head_acc.what: Share of shots that hit the head

head_kills.what: Share of kills that were headshots (csst.at only)

opening_min.what: Lower of CT and T opening-duel win rate

stopping.what: Share of shots taken with good counter-strafing

aim_lead.what: Aim rating minus mean of positioning and utility

not_stopped.what: 100 - stopping: share of shots NOT taken standing still

clutch_rating.what: Leetify clutch rating as the API sends it

recent_mean_rating.what: Mean rating of the recent matches

strong_share_ge_3.what: Share of recent matches rated >= 3 (current strongMatch)

step_effect.what: Newest 10 matches vs. the older ones, pooled std devs

floor_share.what: Share of recent matches at or above rating 0

floor_share_in_form.what: floor_share, only for players with mean rating >= 2

reaction_cv.what: Match-to-match variation of reaction time (sd / mean)

divergence.what: Non-FACEIT matches vs. FACEIT matches, pooled std devs
